chunks: It was narrated to me by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Majiluwayh from his uncle Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from his father from Muhammad ibn Sinan from al-Mufaddal ibn Umar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Fasting in the month of Shaban and the month of Ramadan, two consecutive months, is repentance, by Allah, from Allah.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for fasting continuously in Shaban and Ramadan?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), emphasizing the unique spiritual merit of maintaining a continuous fast through Shaban and Ramadan, which serves as a comprehensive expiation for sins. This practice is viewed in Shia tradition as a means of preparing the soul for the month of fasting, with the 'repentance' mentioned implying a profound cleansing of minor sins and spiritual purification before the arrival of Ramadan.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 3. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. Ali b. Majluwayh from his uncle Muhammad b. Abi al-Qasim from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah from his father from Muhammad b. Sinan from al-Muffadhal b. Umar from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
One who fasts continuously from Shaban to the month of Ramadan then by Allah, these fasts would be counted among repentance of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime.”
